notes: Strict Savigny-lès-Beaune specifications from the effective cahier des charges homologated by decree n°2011-1792. White and red wines are modeled separately at village and Premier Cru level. White wines use Chardonnay and Pinot Blanc. Red accessory Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are mixed-planting exceptions only, so the authoritative positive path remains 100% Pinot Noir. Conditional white fermentable-sugar relief to 4 g/L is conservatively fail-closed at the unconditional 3 g/L ceiling.
